description: Land Acquisition - Ambalanpitiya, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and extents in Kurunegala District. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke) issuing the order, the core content focuses entirely on land matters - the acquisition of specific properties with detailed land descriptions, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). The ministerial reference is incidental to the land acquisition process rather than being the primary focus of the document.
